Our story

Two lives. One unexpected quiz. One beautiful story.

Born just two years apart, in 2000 and 1998, we grew up barely 2 kilometres away from each other. We went to different schools, lived different lives, and eventually went on to different colleges. Somehow, for all those years, our paths never crossed.

And then, 25 years later, life brought us together at IIM Indore.

It all began rather unexpectedly, with a sudden quiz that brought two strangers together for the very first time. What followed was a friendship that lasted a year, filled with conversations, laughter, little moments and memories.

And somewhere along the way, without either of us quite realising when it happened, friendship turned into love.

Perhaps we were never meant to meet sooner. Maybe all those years and all those almost-crossed paths were simply leading us to the right place, at the right time, and to each other.

From living just 2 kilometres apart to finding each other 25 years later, this is our story.
